description:
Upload a profile photo for employee 'Sarah Connor' (EMP-900). A compatible bitmap image file is located at 'C:\workspace\data\sarah_photo.bmp'. 

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Employee module and find 'Sarah Connor'.
2. Open the employee record and go to the 'Photograph' section.
3. Browse and select the file 'C:\workspace\data\sarah_photo.bmp'.
4. Save the record.
